pages.title: Enchanted Gravitite
pages.text: Gravitite Ore enchanted at an Aether $(item)Altar$(). It falls upward, which is exactly what a rocket wants.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Gravitite Ore is a rare ore in Aether Holystone and needs an iron-tier pickaxe ($(item)Zanite$() works). Mine it, then enchant it at an Altar fuelled with Ambrosium. No boss needed; the Aether goes on forever.
